The user's layout is STILL broken on the frontend. We need a definitive, scorched-earth fix.

1. Hero Full Bleed: The video bg is STILL not filling the hero.
Look inside `site/snippets/blocks/split-hero.php`. There must be a `container`, `px-`, `my-`, or `max-w-` class on the outermost `<section>`. REMOVE IT completely.
If the block is rendered via a loop in `site/templates/default.php` or `site/snippets/layouts.php`, the wrapper `<div>` or `<section>` generated by the layout builder MIGHT have `container` hardcoded. You must modify the layout rendering code to output `<div class="w-full">` for the hero block instead of a boxed container. Use `w-[100vw]` or `w-screen relative left-1/2 right-1/2 -mx-[50vw]` if you have to break out of a parent constraint.

2. Bento Grid: The user said "The items are all over the place on height based on content. The gaps between items seems a mess. Im seeing rounded corners on the bento."
- In `bento-grid.php`, force `grid-auto-rows: 240px !important;`. 
- In `bento-grid.php`, explicitly add `gap-4 md:gap-6` to the grid container. DO NOT rely on CSS variables if they aren't working.
- Remove ANY `rounded` classes (`rounded-lg`, `rounded-xl`, etc.) from the bento items.
- In `bento-items/bento-media.php`, ensure the image wrapper is `absolute inset-0 w-full h-full` and the image is `object-cover`.
- Make sure text items have `overflow-hidden` so they don't break the cell height.

Instructions: Fix these issues forcefully. Signal completion.
